conclusion: Every rigid internal seam mapped to x1=0 or x2=0 forces overlap, so the rigid axis-seam origami strategy is impossible.
theorem: If two different rigid unimodular-affine pieces share an internal seam edge whose common image is a unit edge on x1=0 or x2=0 in the target simplex, then the two source unit triangles adjacent to that seam edge must map to the same unique target unit triangle incident to that boundary edge. Hence each seam edge forces one overlapping target triangle; a seam of length L forces at least L overlaps.
